name: Empty Brown Waterskin
summary: The Empty Brown Waterskin is an elemental vessel provided by Brine during a shaman's trials in the Barrens. Used to gather water from a nearby oasis, it serves as the first physical tool in learning the delicate, contested nature of water in an arid land.

sections.title: A Lesson in Scarcity
sections.body: In the sun-baked plains of the Barrens, water is far more than a resource; it is life itself and a constant spark for war. The hermit Brine entrusts an initiate with this simple leather skin as the opening trial of the Call of Water. The task seems modest—carry the empty vessel down to the watering hole beneath her dwelling and bring it back full. Yet in drawing from that solitary pool, the bearer immediately confronts the harsh truth of the land: every drop of liquid is jealously guarded by local quilboar who view the oasis as an invaluable hoard, forcing the initiate to understand how water both sustains life and drives mortals to violence.

faq.q: What is the Empty Brown Waterskin used for?
faq.answer: It is an empty container given to shaman initiates by Brine. Its purpose is to draw water from the natural pond situated directly beneath her hut in the Barrens, creating a filled waterskin necessary to prepare elemental sapta.
Brine, a knowledgeable hermit residing in the southern reaches of the Barrens, provides the vessel to shamans undertaking their elemental pilgrimage to commune with the spirits of water.

faq.q: Why are the quilboar defending the water source?
faq.answer: Water is extraordinarily scarce throughout the Barrens. To the quilboar, even a small watering hole represents vast wealth and survival. Because rain is rare, they guard every spring with ferocious greed, attacking anyone who dares draw from it.

faq.q: What happens once the skin is filled?
faq.answer: Once dipped into the oasis beneath Brine's hill, it becomes a Filled Brown Waterskin. Returning it to Brine allows her to test your understanding of nature's balance before sending you across the world for rarer waters.

angles.text: Carrying this waterskin is a rite of passage for Horde shamans seeking their Water Totem, demonstrating the balance between reverence for the elements and the harsh struggles of mortal survival.
